subject: general
question: What do you call a base that dissolves in water?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alkali.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An alkali is a basic,** ionic salt of an alkali metal.**
